title: a bin/cairn run from a worktree leaves the live instance's links where they point
intention: A bin/cairn run from a checkout that is not the house never repoints an existing link under the live instance root to its own tree; only a missing link is laid.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: `bin/cairn outlinecheck` run from /home/akien/dev/src/wt-e179 at 12:51 left ~/.cairn/devices/superclaude/0/bin/superclaude -> /home/akien/dev/src/wt-e179/cairn/cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py. bin/cairn.py's _superclaude_stale reads any link that does not resolve to THIS checkout's superclaude.py as stale, _wiring_gap then fires _wire_instances, and _wire_link repoints every stale symlink to the running checkout. So the live launcher follows whichever tree ran last, and clearing a worktree leaves it dangling. The other 19 live instance links read rewritten at 12:53, the next house run, which suggests they had moved too (not yet measured directly).
traces_to: Law 6 (everything has one owner: the live instance's links are the house's, and a worktree writes them ambiently) and CLAUDE.md's three roots (class-space code in a scratch tree reaching into instance-space).
how: In bin/cairn.py, _superclaude_stale and _wire_link treat a symlink as stale only when it dangles or points outside every checkout of this repo (git rev-parse --git-common-dir equal); a link into another checkout of the same repo is left. A red-first proof runs a worktree's bin/cairn over a scratch instance root whose links point at a second scratch checkout and needs them unchanged.

clauses.claim: a bin/cairn run from checkout B over an instance root whose superclaude and class-verb links point into checkout A of the same repo leaves every link pointing into A
the same run over an instance root with a link absent lays that link
a link that dangles, or points at the bash superclaude, is repointed as today

decisions.text: D1: bin/cairn.py's _superclaude_stale and _wire_link judge a symlink stale only when it dangles, or resolves outside every worktree of this repo (git rev-parse --git-common-dir of the link's target tree equals the running checkout's), or (for superclaude) resolves to the bash superclaude; a live link into another checkout of this repo stands.

D2: the red-first proof bin/proofs/test_a_worktree_run_leaves_the_live_links_alone.py, PROVES e36513d126cf keys 1-3, makes two scratch git worktrees of one scratch repo carrying a stub bin/cairn.py tree, and drives the real bin/cairn.py's wiring functions over a scratch CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT; one tooth per clause.

constraints: a proof launch never uses the live instance root
the house remains the one checkout whose runs repoint a dangling live link

measured.saw: ~/.cairn/devices/superclaude/0/bin/superclaude -> /home/akien/dev/src/wt-e179/cairn/cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py, mtime 12:51, after `bin/cairn outlinecheck e179281f6eff` from wt-e179

bin/cairn.py _superclaude_stale returns True for a symlink whose resolve() is not CLASS_ROOT/cc/superclaude.py of the running checkout; _wire_link repoints any symlink whose resolve() differs from the running script
measured.how: read of bin/cairn.py lines 183-249 in wt-e179

measured.saw: the orchestrator ruled: cast its own ticket, do not build it before e179281f6eff; CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT set to scratch for worktree runs stands meanwhile
